label: Brønnøysundregistrene
terms_note: Open REST API without a key (NLOD licence); entities include registered e-mail / phone / website where filed.

adapter.rate_note: No rate limit is documented (https://data.brreg.no/enhetsregisteret/api/dokumentasjon/no/index.html); client-side bucket kept at the runtime default of 2/s. Result sets are capped: 'Resultatsettet er begrenset til 10 000 enheter per spørring'.

me.note: Open data without credentials: verified with a one-item entity search (no account endpoint).

search.note: Norwegian register only: `query` is the `navn` name search; `country` and `industry` are ignored. `page` is zero-based on the API ('page: Integer, zero-based (default 0)') — the 1-based `page` argument is converted; (page+1)*size must stay <= 10 000. `address` is the first line of forretningsadresse.adresse; `size` is the employee count (antallAnsatte); `industry` is naeringskode1.beskrivelse (Norwegian). Live check 2026-09-24: Accept: application/json returns the current (v2) representation.

get_company.note: `id` is the nine-digit organisasjonsnummer. 404 when unknown; '410 Gone' when 'Fjernet av juridiske årsaker' (removed for legal reasons) → platform_error.

live_check.notes: fixed: size (antallAnsatte) is an integer, the vocabulary a string: schema-invalid for strict clients; mapped with str:; all read tools answered, schema-valid, pagination advances
